newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Multinationals not paying enough, say Chinese.
newsitem.headline: Multinationals not paying enough, say Chinese.

text.p: A majority of mainland Chinese working for multinational companies in China say they are underpaid, a U.S.-based research company has found.

Some 67 percent of the 5,625 employees surveyed said they were "very much" underpaid, while 59 percent said they suffered excessive job pressure, the independent International Survey Research said in a statement on Tuesday.
The year-long employee opinion survey, touted as the first in China, ended in July and covered Chinese employees working with multinational joint venture companies throughout China.
Up to 56 percent were frequently concerned about the future of their company, the survey found.
However, 46 percent responded favourably when asked about job satisfaction.
